description: ⊆ and ⊈ compare two tag sets, and ∅ takes its kind from the other side of =. Only the first alternative of text holds, since V ⊈ $x.tags fails where $x carries V (engine §10).
grammar:
%rule text (p q r) | (p s r)
%rule p $x:W %conditions V ⊆ $x.tags
%rule q $x:W %conditions Tag-v ⊈ $x.tags
%rule r $x:W %conditions ($x.tags ∖ (V ∪ W)) = ∅, ($x.tags ∩ Tag-v) = ∅
%rule s $x:W %conditions V ⊈ $x.tags
